contents.name: AK-47
contents.label: AK-47
contents.notes: VIEWMODEL STRATEGY (M4-RIG DRIVER, 2026-06-03): secondaryReference now points to the CUSTOM vm_ak47.prefab, which was rebuilt by cloning the working vm_m4a1 rig. The M4 viewmodel model (v_m4a1.vmdl) is the master SkinnedModelRenderer (CreateBoneObjects + UseAnimGraph) so it supplies the real 'camera' bone, animgraph, and hand IK that the custom AK model lacked; it is rendered with equipment/vm_ak47/invisible.vmat (Complex shader, F_TRANSLUCENT, opacity 0 + tint alpha 0) so the M4 mesh is never seen. The textured AK (v_ak47.vmdl) is bonemerged on top of the M4 master (the AK rig reuses M4 bone names: weapon_root/muzzle/stock/trigger/magazine...). Arms (v_first_person_arms_human) bonemerge to the master, same as M4. __references pin facepunch.v_m4a1#152506 + facepunch.v_first_person_arms_human#205798. CONTINGENT ON EDITOR VERIFICATION: open the DXRP project, confirm invisible.vmat hides the M4 and the AK sits in-hand (lp_give_ak), then sync DXRP->repo and publish. FALLBACK (Option A): if the custom VM fails verification, set secondaryReference back to secondaryReferencePlaceholder (gameplay/equipment/weapons/m4a1/vm_m4a1.prefab) to ship the functional M4-placeholder VM. 3rd-person hold (w_ak47.prefab Model child) still needs a live editor nudge: remove the 0,0,1,0 180-flip and move the Muzzle/EjectionPort empties off the -459 X leftover (M4 ref: Muzzle 20.07571,0,7.212921 / Ejection 1.774985,-0.4210945,7.672482). Remove Code/Addons/lifepunch/ak47/Ak47DevGive.cs (lp_give_ak) before publish.

addons.title: lifepunch.ulx
addons.description: lifepunch.ulx is a server-agnostic, in-game staff UI/UX for any DXRP.net-powered server — a clean, permission-aware command console that acts as a thin presentation and dispatch layer over DXRP's native admin backend, surfacing only the actions a viewer's portal rank permits and reflecting live RankSystem and portal-API data (roster, roles, balances, health/armor) in real time.

No rights granted to anyone else by presence in this repo or on the DXRP portal.
addons.notes: Server-agnostic in-game staff/admin menu (portal package 'DXRP Admin Menu', network identifier 'dxrpadminmenu'; repo ident 'adminmenu'). Thin UX + dispatch layer over DXRP's existing admin backend: gates each action on Dxura.RP.Shared.Permission via RankSystem.HasLocalPermission, respects RankSystem.CanLocalTarget, and dispatches to AdminSystem [Rpc.Host] actions where one exists (Kick) else Chat.ExecuteCommandHost into the registered ICommand (Freeze/Goto/Bring/Spectate/God). Opens via the 'adminmenu' (and legacy 'staffmenu') console + chat command (staff bind any key to it). code-only kind: V1 uses the material-icons font, ships no image assets. LIFEPUNCH_LOCAL stubs keep it editor-compilable. Permission Id strings reconcile 1:1 with admin-panel/permissions/*.json. Code namespace/class names remain LifePunch.DXRP.Addons.StaffMenu (StaffMenu*.cs) — functional, not renamed with the package ident.
